import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleLocalizationMorphisms
import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildePullback

/-!
# Principal-open restrictions of invariant module sheaves

Restriction of the associated invariant sheaf to a principal open is the
associated sheaf of fixed localized vectors. The comparison uses the actual
localization action on the original module, so it identifies the modules
needed for overlap transitions in Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L R : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R] [IsScalarTower K L R]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R] [IsSemilinear K L R]
  (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
  [Finite (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]

local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- Extension of the invariant module to a principal open identifies with
the fixed vectors of the localized original module. -/
noncomputable def tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv (f : A) :
    (Localization.Away f ⊗[A] invariantModule K L R M) ≃ₗ[Localization.Away f]
      localizedInvariantModule K L R M f := by
  let e := IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers f)
    (TensorProduct.mk A (Localization.Away f) (invariantModule K L R M) 1)
  exact (e.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization (Submonoid.powers f) (Localization.Away f)).symm.trans
    (invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f)

@[simp]
theorem tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv_one_tmul (f : A)
    (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f (1 ⊗ₜ[A] m) :
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) = LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) 1 := by
  change (invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f
    ((IsLocalizedModule.iso (Submonoid.powers f)
      (TensorProduct.mk A (Localization.Away f) (invariantModule K L R M) 1)).symm
        (1 ⊗ₜ[A] m)) : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) = _
  rw [show (1 ⊗ₜ[A] m) =
    TensorProduct.mk A (Localization.Away f) (invariantModule K L R M) 1 m from rfl,
    IsLocalizedModule.iso_symm_apply, invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk]

variable (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R N]

/-- The tensor comparison intertwines scalar extension of an invariant map
with localization of the original equivariant map. -/
theorem tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv_naturality (b : A) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (x : Localization.Away b ⊗[A] invariantModule K L R M) :
    localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf
        (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M b x) =
      tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R N b
        ((invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf).baseChange (Localization.Away b) x) := by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul t m =>
      rw [show t ⊗ₜ[A] m = t • (1 ⊗ₜ[A] m) by
        simp only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]]
      simp only [map_smul]
      congr 1
      have hm : tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M b (1 ⊗ₜ[A] m) =
          invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M b (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp only [tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv_one_tmul, invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk]
      rw [hm, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
      have hn : tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R N b
          (1 ⊗ₜ[A] invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf m) =
          invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R N b
            (LocalizedModule.mk (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf m) 1) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp only [tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv_one_tmul, invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk]
      rw [hn]
      simpa only [LocalizedModule.map_mk] using
        invariantLocalizationEquiv_naturality K L R M N b f hf (LocalizedModule.mk m 1)
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

/-- The native restriction of an invariant associated sheaf to a principal
open is the associated sheaf of fixed localized vectors. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleTildeRestrictionIso (f : A) :
    let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of A
    let T : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away f)
    (tilde (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T))) ≅
        tilde (ModuleCat.of T (localizedInvariantModule K L R M f)) := by
  dsimp
  let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of A
  let T : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away f)
  exact MilneLib.restrictSpecTildeTensorIso (S := T)
      (ModuleCat.of S (invariantModule K L R M)) ≪≫
    (tilde.functor T).mapIso (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f).toModuleIso

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
-- The native restriction square compares several nested fixed-ring module structures.
/-- The principal-open comparison commutes with the native restriction of
the sheaf map induced by an equivariant module map. -/
theorem invariantModuleTildeRestrictionIso_hom_naturality (b : A) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m) :
    let S : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of A
    let T : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away b)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S T)))).map
        ((tilde.functor S).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf))) ≫
        (invariantModuleTildeRestrictionIso K L R N b).hom =
      (invariantModuleTildeRestrictionIso K L R M b).hom ≫
        (tilde.functor T).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf)) := by
  dsimp only
  let T : CommRingCat := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away b)
  have h : ModuleCat.ofHom ((invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf).baseChange T) ≫
        (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R N b).toModuleIso.hom =
      (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M b).toModuleIso.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (localizedInvariantModuleMap K L R M N b f hf) := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (tensorInvariantLocalizationEquiv_naturality K L R M N b f hf x).symm
  simp only [invariantModuleTildeRestrictionIso, id_eq, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  erw [← Category.assoc, MilneLib.restrictSpecTildeTensorIso_hom_naturality
      (R := CommRingCat.of A) (S := T)
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (invariantModuleMap K L R M N f hf)),
    Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, h, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
